modmenu.descriptionTranslation.liveevent: Admin-triggered live cosmic and natural events (supernovas, meteor showers, earthquakes) with cinematic client-side visuals and real, revertible effects on the world.
death.attack.liveevents.stellar_burn: %1$s burned under the light of a dying star
death.attack.liveevents.stellar_burn.pla: %1$s burned under a dying star while fighting %2$s
death.attack.liveevents.meteor_impact.pl: %1$s was crushed by a meteorite while fighting %2$s
death.attack.liveevents.seismic.player: %1$s was swallowed by the earth while fighting %2$s
event.liveevents.supernova.description: The red giant collapses, shatters the sky and leaves a nebula and a pulsar behind.
event.liveevents.supernova.title: Betelgeuse is dying
event.liveevents.supernova.subtitle: Find shelter from the sky
event.liveevents.supernova.phase.agony: The Bloody Agony and the Dreadful Void
event.liveevents.supernova.phase.breakou: The Violent Lash and the Atmospheric Rupture
event.liveevents.supernova.phase.demon_s: Apocalypse of Light: a Demon Sun in the Night
event.liveevents.supernova.phase.plasma_: The Plasma Storm and the Macabre Dance of Colours
event.liveevents.supernova.phase.eternal: The Eternal Scar and the Possessed Heart
event.liveevents.meteor_shower.descripti: Fireballs rain down, open craters and set the ground ablaze.
event.liveevents.meteor_shower.title: Something is coming
event.liveevents.meteor_shower.subtitle: Watch the ground: embers mark each impact
event.liveevents.earthquake.description: The ground roars, cracks open along a fault line and cliffs crumble.
death.attack.liveevents.acid.player: %1$s dissolved in acid rain while fighting %2$s
event.liveevents.aurora_borealis.descrip: A calm night of green and violet curtains. Harmless: made for series and screenshots.
event.liveevents.total_eclipse.descripti: The moon swallows the sun: darkness at noon, a ghostly corona and the diamond ring.
event.liveevents.total_eclipse.title: The sun is fading
event.liveevents.total_eclipse.subtitle: Do not look away
event.liveevents.solar_storm.description: A solar flare floods the sky with auroras and radiation; lightning strikes the exposed.
event.liveevents.solar_storm.title: Solar flare detected
event.liveevents.solar_storm.subtitle: Stay under a roof
event.liveevents.great_meteor.descriptio: A single huge fireball: a huge crater, a shockwave and a cloud of dust.
event.liveevents.great_meteor.title: Incoming impact
event.liveevents.great_meteor.subtitle: Get away from the marked area
event.liveevents.blizzard.description: A white wall of snow: almost no visibility, slowness outdoors and frozen water.
event.liveevents.acid_rain.description: Toxic rain that burns the skin, withers crops and corrodes the surface.
event.liveevents.black_hole.description: A singularity opens above the ground, pulls everything in and collapses into a crater.
event.liveevents.black_hole.title: Gravitational anomaly
event.liveevents.black_hole.subtitle: Run against the pull
liveevents.preview.started: Preview of %s (#%s, profile %s): only you see it and the world does not change
liveevents.panic: EMERGENCY STOP: %s events stopped and all client effects cut
liveevents.revert.done: Revert finished: %s restored, %s skipped (changed by players), %s in unloaded chunks
liveevents.revert.partial: Partial revert: %s restored, %s skipped, %s in unloaded chunks. Run it again when those chunks are loaded
liveevents.debug.title: LiveEvents · timeline
liveevents.debug.none: No active events in this dimension
liveevents.notify.module_failed: Module %s of event #%s failed and was disabled (the rest continues)
liveevents.watchdog.reduced: Server overloaded (%s ms/tick): event work reduced to the minimum
liveevents.watchdog.paused: Server still overloaded (%s ms/tick): events paused. Resume them with /le resume
liveevents.error.no_permission_event: You do not have permission to start %s
liveevents.error.no_permission_anywhere: You can only start events at your own position (needs liveevents:start.anywhere)
liveevents.error.no_sky: %s needs a sky (not available in the Nether)
liveevents.error.night_required: %s can only be started at night
liveevents.error.max_concurrent: Too many active events (max %s). Add queue to queue it
liveevents.error.celestial_conflict: %s is already in the sky of this dimension. Add queue to queue it
liveevents.error.hardcore_confirm: Hardcore world: %s can kill players. Add confirm to start it
liveevents.error.journal_active: Event #%s is still running; stop it before reverting
liveevents.error.bad_new_id: Invalid id %s: use namespace:name (the liveevents namespace is reserved)
liveevents.error.gui_too_big: Too many events to show in the panel
liveevents.error.client_missing: The admin panel needs LiveEvents installed on your client

liveevents.client.protocol_mismatch: The server uses LiveEvents %s and you have %s. Update LiveEvents to see the events correctly.
liveevents.client.panic_on: Event effects disabled (press again to restore)
liveevents.config.title: LiveEvents options
liveevents.config.hint: Effects always follow the flash rule and your vanilla accessibility options
liveevents.gui.title: LiveEvents · admin panel
